areas.t: Wednesday through Friday, with a persistent surface high pressure system to the northeast and surface low pressure lingering over the Gulf, light to moderate easterly to east-northeasterly winds will disperse pollutants and bring clean air into the Bayou State. As a result, AQI levels will remain Go
